name: fx_gato_t0
doc: Stands in for saves/gato_t0.state and saves/battle_re/gato_t0.raw.wram (the suite's GATO seed): from GATO's last box (fx_a_battle_gato_press_action: battle_gato_press_action after the attract demo, the reference's gato_press_action.state) the reference's own input (A held 20 of every 60 frames) runs 145 frames: the box closes and this is the last frame before GATO's song sequence; the play clock $0400 moves 2 s 25 f, as from the reference to its capture, and the text-box bytes $0126-$0135 are the capture's.
